phases.message: Our appraisal notices came. Start in Mailnest: read every notice and work out each deadline, and find anything about the house's condition that matters to its value.
This is Deedvault, the county's deed records. Check what we actually own.
Now Compsmith. Look at the sales for each property and work out which ones are real comparables.
And this is Countyline's protest portal. Protest every property the comparable sales don't support, with its opinion of value, and submit its evidence with it, each sale and document on its own.

rules.text: Topics: deadline, owner, grounds, comparables, condition, opinion. Protests for tax year 2026 are filed here; the appraisal review board hears them.
File by May 15 or by the 30th day after the notice of appraised value was delivered, whichever is later (Tax Code §41.44(a)). A late protest is dismissed unless good cause is shown.
Only the owner of the property on January 1 of the tax year, or an agent the owner appointed on Form 50-162, may protest (§41.41). A notice sent to a former owner gives them no right to protest.

The usual ground is that the market value is more than the property would sell for on January 1, 2026 (§41.41(a)(1)). A protest needs evidence that the value is too high: if your comparable sales support the notice's value, the board will keep it.

A comparable sale must have occurred within 24 months of January 1, 2026 in this county, unless too few sales exist (§23.013(b)); it must be an open-market sale between unrelated parties (§1.04(7)); and it must be alike in location, size, age and condition (§23.013(d)). The board gives no weight to sales that fail any of these.

A defect that existed on January 1 lowers market value by its cost to cure, shown by an engineer's report or a contractor's estimate for the repair. Upgrades you would like to make, and defects already repaired, do not.

State your opinion of value as the median of the adjusted prices of the comparable sales you submit, less the cost to cure any documented defect. With two comparables the median is their average. File the protest and submit its evidence together, one sale or document at a time.
